description: Metadata for one current law or central regulation from Lovdata (title, short title, date, ministry, last change, link to lovdata.no) and its table of contents: section ids, chapters and headings. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

id.description: Lovdata id, e.g. lov/2005-06-17-62 (a law) or forskrift/2010-01-29-72 (a regulation). Put it in the path as written, slash included.

name: get_law
title: Get one law or regulation
